definitions.explanation: The act of imposing a penalty on someone who has committed an offense or violated a rule, especially in legal or institutional contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{基|もと}づいて→基づく：02315_motozuku⟧{処罰|しょばつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To punish according to the law.

examples.japanese: ⟦{不正行為|ふせいこうい}→不正行為：25084_fuseikoui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{処罰|しょばつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: The employee who committed misconduct received punishment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{飲酒運転|いんしゅうんてん}→飲酒運転：18486_inshuunten⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対|たい}する→対する：02126_taisuru⟧{処罰|しょばつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{年々|ねんねん}→年々：10417_nennen⟧⟦{厳|きび}しく→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧⟦なっている→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Penalties for drunk driving have been getting stricter year by year.

notes:
A formal term for punishment, most commonly used in legal, institutional, and organizational contexts. Composed of {処|しょ} (deal with, manage) + ⟦{罰|ばつ}→罰：10154_batsu⟧ (punishment).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {処罰|しょばつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to receive punishment
- {処罰|しょばつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to punish, to penalize
- ⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧{処罰|しょばつ}: severe punishment
- {処罰|しょばつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対象|たいしょう}→対象：03393_taishou⟧: subject to punishment

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{罰|ばつ}→罰：10154_batsu⟧: punishment — more general and colloquial; used in everyday contexts
- ⟦{刑罰|けいばつ}→刑罰：20566_keibatsu⟧: criminal penalty — specifically a punishment under criminal law
- ⟦{懲罰|ちょうばつ}→懲罰：21095_choubatsu⟧: disciplinary punishment — emphasizes corrective or disciplinary intent
- ⟦{制裁|せいさい}→制裁：11846_seisai⟧: sanctions, retribution — punishment imposed to enforce compliance, often used in international contexts
